datasets.name: ods_court
datasets.sql:
select 
json_object('id' value o.servc_id) Checked,c.id ,person,persontype,c.name ,o.servc_id,o.checked_id from court_online o,customers c  where persontype=0 and o.person=c.inn--person in('4401346432','1403586421')
union all
select 
json_object('id' value o.servc_id)  Checked,-1 as id ,person,persontype,'' as name ,o.servc_id,-1 as checked_id from court_online o  where persontype=0 and  not EXISTS (select * from customers where inn=o.person)

union all


select 
json_object('id' value o.servc_id) Checked,c.idcust id ,person,persontype,c.lastname||' '||c.name||' '||c.soname as name,o.servc_id,o.checked_id from
 court_online o,custinfo c  where persontype=1 and o.person=c.passpin--person in('4401346432','1403586421')
union all
select 
json_object('id' value o.servc_id)  Checked,-1 as id ,person,persontype,'' as name ,o.servc_id,-1 as checked_id from 
court_online o  where persontype=1 and  not EXISTS (select * from custinfo where passpin=o.person)

datasets.name: ods_accountpasspin
datasets.sql:
select a.id, a.servc_id,a.passpin,
json_object( 'CheckedId' value checked_id ,
    'AccountNumber'value a.acc_no,'AccountType' value a.tipacc,'Balance' value a.pok_ostat,'Currency'value 
    a.currencyname ,'OpenDate'value opendat,'CloseDate'value closedat, 'Status' value a.status)
text
 from (
select i.idcust id,o.servc_id,i.passpin,o.checked_id,
     a.acc_no,a.name as tipacc,a.currencyname ,
      to_char(a.open_dat, 'yyyy-mm-dd"T"hh24:mi:ss') as opendat,
      to_char(a.close_dat,'yyyy-mm-dd"T"hh24:mi:ss') as closedat,
      case when a.close_dat is null then 'OPEN'else 'CLOSE' end Status,
      (select abs(pok_ostat) from tenostat where acc_id=a.id)as pok_ostat
     
     from account a,custinfo i ,court_online o where 
    i.idcust=a.kli_id and  i.passpin=o.person ) a where nvl(passpin,0)=:v_passpin

datasets.name: ods_accountInn
datasets.sql:
select a.id, a.servc_id,a.inn,pass_inn,
json_object( 'CheckedId' value checked_id ,
    'AccountNumber'value a.acc_no,'AccountType' value a.tipacc,'Balance' value a.pok_ostat,'Currency'value 
    a.currencyname ,'OpenDate'value opendat,'CloseDate'value closedat, 'Status' value a.status)
text
 from (
select i.id,o.servc_id,i.inn,o.checked_id,
     a.acc_no,a.name as tipacc,a.currencyname ,
      to_char(a.open_dat, 'yyyy-mm-dd"T"hh24:mi:ss') as opendat,
      to_char(a.close_dat,'yyyy-mm-dd"T"hh24:mi:ss') as closedat,
      case when a.close_dat is null then 'OPEN'else 'CLOSE' end Status,
      case when length(o.person)=7 then 1 else 2 end pass_inn,
     (select abs(pok_ostat) from tenostat where acc_id=a.id)as pok_ostat
     
     from account a,customers i ,court_online o where 
    i.id=a.kli_id and  i.inn=o.person ) a where nvl(inn,0)=:v_inn

datasets.name: ods_depositinn
datasets.sql:
select json_object(
'CheckedId' value 'a.checked_id',
'Amount'    value a.Amount,
'ContractNumber' value a.ContractNumber,
'Currency'    value a.Currency,
'DepositRate' value   a.DepositRate,
'DepositType'    value a.DepositType,
'MaturityDate'    value a.MaturityDate,
'StartDate'    value a.StartDate,
'Description'   value a.Description,
'AccountNumber'    value a.AccountNumber,
'CalculatedInterestAmount'  value a.CalculatedInterestAmount,
'Status'  value  a.Status
)text
 from  (

SELECT 
    c.customerid                                                  Customerid,
    c.amount                                                      Amount, 
    c.contractno                                                  ContractNumber, 
    (select val_name from avalute where valute=c.currency)        Currency,
    (select interest from sbcm_interests where id#=c.id)          DepositRate,
    (select  type from sbcm_deposit_types where id=c.contracttype)DepositType,
    c.closedate                                                   MaturityDate,    
    c.opendate                                                    StartDate,
    'Default'                                                     Description,
    (select acc_no from account where id=a.contractaccid)         AccountNumber,
    h.facticalinterestdebt                                        CalculatedInterestAmount,
    c.type#                                                       Status,
    cu.inn
    
  FROM sbcm_contracts c, sbcm_contract_accounts a, sbcm_contract_history h,customers cu,court_online o
 WHERE c.id = a.id# AND a.id# = h.id# and h.hdate=sbop.get_date and c.customerid=cu.id and cu.inn=o.person) a 
 where inn=:v_inn
